visual: Large fine-wire sphere on black, rotating yield verbs, blue and teal orbital illustrations for two product branches, thin outlined controls and dark statistic cards.
judgment: Strong visual system for separating related tools while keeping a single technical brand.
role: Yield trading protocol. PENDLE governance/eligible staking rewards; current sPENDLE replaces winding-down vePENDLE. Not required payment currency.
routes: Boros margin and V2 spot routes each pair app access with explanation; docs/education/analytics in footer.
loop: Yield markets and governance participation create reasons to return; no trades or reward flows tested.
trust: Education, public code and external analytics links visible; marketing superlatives unverified.
counter: Thin lines and low-contrast type can reduce accessibility; animated counters and logos captured before fully settling.
principle: Assign each product a consistent accent and related geometric form, with a clear two-path choice.
avoid: Do not assume animated statistics are settled values or repeat risk claims outside their specific context.
idea: Separate PONS creator tools and market intelligence with two related colours and clearly different user journeys.
limitations: Product titles, metric counters and partner logos show animation/stitch seams. Static composite should not be used as a metrics record.
